source.note: known-divergences.md, click-reserved-word: a `click` here does not start a click statement, so this specification rejects the input, which mermaid.js accepts; its reference input, without the comment regions and without the click text of that `click`, is rejected by mermaid.js, because the `,` among the click ids becomes a `,` unit, which a subgraph name does not take.
